core_rules.text: 保留深黑作为空间边界，同时让主体所在的中间调可读；黑框面积不作为统一曝光目标
大面积背景色克制，重要物体或光源可以有选择地高饱和；不全局洗灰
保留真实光线方向、光源发光感和石材、纸张、树皮等材质差异
使用局部明暗与前中后景关系引导视线；允许场景具有不同亮度和色温

allowed_variation: 天空可蓝青或靛蓝，按真实条件
已有深黑框景可以接近纯黑
forbidden: 虚构EXIF、作者参数、能力、已执行操作或检查结果
把画中画或不合格参考当作有效肤色标定
将待修图或成片自动加入授权参考库
将生成或创意演绎内容冒充已核实拍摄事实

composition_policy.user_instruction: 重构此条构图规则，解放构图边界
composition_policy.principle: 以最终视觉表达为目标，主动选择最有力量的构图；可自由保留、优化或重构原片，不以原取景、原主体位置、完整性、画幅或改动幅度作为默认边界。

PRESERVE.condition: 实际比较后原取景最符合本片表达；保留是一种主动选择
PRESERVE.action: 采用原构图或不改变几何，以光影色彩完成表达

OPTIMIZE.condition: 调整主体、留白、边缘、方向或几何可强化表达
OPTIMIZE.action: 自主决定裁切、比例、旋转及几何调整幅度，按最终表现选择

REFRAME.condition: 重新组织取景与注意力能得到更有力量的画面，即使原构图已经合格也可采用
REFRAME.action: 允许大幅裁切、横竖转换、重新定位视觉主体和重心、局部抽象取景，以及按用途必要的创意补景与干扰整理

criteria: 表达与情绪
视觉主体和注意力分配
主体尺度、局部细节与画面节奏
留白、遮挡、前后层次与环境取舍
光影、色块、引导线和透视关系
实际观看尺寸与输出可用性

creative_composition.when: 为画面表达提供明确收益时，可自主使用；保真几何路线已能满足目标时直接完成，不为炫技强加生成操作。
creative_composition.protected_information: 保留可识别主体身份、作品题字与印章、产品关键信息及事件事实；改变这些信息须有当次明确创作意图。纪实、证据、档案用途优先服从其真实性要求。
creative_composition.execution: 内容生成或清理必须使用实际支持的工具并检查实际输出，必要时加载imagegen；记录生成/移除/重排区域，不把补出的内容称为现场事实。

composition_policy.tradeoffs: 允许舍弃非关键环境、原主体的部分外轮廓或大面积原片像素；依据表达与真实输出质量取舍，不以固定完整性或比例自动否决。
composition_policy.local_emphasis: 构图与光影色彩协同决定；选定实际取景后完成依赖区域的测量和蒙版。
quality_rules: 不预设保留原图或轻裁优先，也不要求每张强行变化；选择表达更有效者
保留原文件，在可回退副本上执行；按实际用途检查人物、材质、文字、几何及内容改动
按真实保留像素、放大质量与观看用途判断输出可用性，不虚构分辨率或已执行效果
生成内容和原始内容分开记录，检查接缝、重复物体、光影透视与保护信息
默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
composition_policy.measurement_order: 几何或内容改动后重新核对有效画面、参考适配与蒙版；建议未应用时统计仍属于原图，不冒称已重测。
composition_policy.analysis_boundary: 看图的助手完成审美判断；数值引擎只携带现行规则，不伪装自动视觉评分或已应用构图。
composition_policy.reference_images: read-only; policy applies to EDIT_TARGET, not analysis evidence or authorized source references
composition_policy.legacy_override: style_config.json内的旧composition_policy仅为冻结数值配置的兼容快照；加载时必须采用本独立现行规则。

A.name: 晴天城市与建筑
A.identification: 直射或方向明确的日光、天空与石材立面；先排除车内黑框。
A.rule: 天空保留蓝青层次，石材暖灰；不要把日光照片修成夜景。
A.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
A.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

B.name: 阴天与低对比街景
B.identification: 软阴影、石材中间调、低反差；晴阴不能仅从暗度判断。
B.rule: 用局部中间调对比建立立体感，避免全局加去朦胧造成脏灰。
B.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
B.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

C.name: 雨天与湿润反射
C.identification: 明确雨滴、伞面或路面反射；仅潮湿外观不能证明正在下雨。
C.rule: 湿路反射比邻近路面亮，但应弱于主光源；不全图强化水滴。
C.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
C.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

D.name: 日落与黄昏
D.identification: 自然粉橙至灰蓝天空、远山与水面剪影；需区分自然天空和人工橙灯，精确时刻未知
D.rule: 允许天空与湖面较亮，保留柔和色彩渐变；亭阁和人物剪影不强行提亮；不添加人工琥珀灯色
D.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
D.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

E.name: 蓝调时刻
E.identification: 天空仍有色彩层次，人工暖光已明显；需要视觉或时间证据。
E.rule: 分别处理天空与暖窗，不用全局色温制造两种光。
E.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
E.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

F.name: 深夜城市与人工灯光
F.identification: 人工光源主导、天空深蓝或暗背景；不能由低亮度单独触发。
F.rule: 灯芯可以接近白色，灯晕暖色；避免蓝色阴影吞没楼体。
F.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
F.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

G.name: 暖光室内、书店与咖啡馆
G.identification: 书页、木材、人工暖光，中间调需可读。
G.rule: 纸张呈温暖的白色，木材有层次；不能把书脊文字压没。
G.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
G.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

H.name: 高反差与混合光
H.identification: 局部亮源与暗背景并存，或不同色温分区。
H.rule: 按光区分别校色，优先保护主体和光源层次。；自然树荫与受光树干分别判断，不能靠全局抬暗部抹平日光层次
H.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
H.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

I.name: 自然景观、树木与植物
I.identification: 以植物为主体时使用；若只是背景树木，仅用植物局部规则。
I.rule: 保留受光叶片与阴影、真实水面和主体材质；植物蒙版减去车辆、衣物、天空与路牌。蓝色水面不用天空蒙版，不把整幅树冠压成暗橄榄色
I.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
I.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

J.name: 人像与环境人像
J.identification: 清晰人物面部或皮肤为重要主体；屏幕里的照片不算肤色样本。
J.rule: 先保护肤色和面部亮度；不依据城市夜景参考强行染肤色。
J.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
J.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

K.name: 车窗、玻璃与遮挡
K.identification: 车内边框、后视镜、伞沿或玻璃遮挡；主体在窗口有效区域。
K.rule: 曝光判断以可见主体为准；近黑框架保留，不整体提亮车厢。
K.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
K.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

L.name: 特殊或未知场景
L.identification: 无法可靠确认场景或样本分布之外；数值相似不等于语义相同。
L.rule: 采用弱风格基准，保留曝光和白平衡自由度。
L.raw_temperature_policy: 区间仅为人工校白起点；不从成片反推拍摄色温，不自动写入
L.visual_time_certainty: inferred or unknown, never solely determined from brightness

PARTIAL.condition: 参考只支持部分区域、材质或光色关系，整体场景证据不足。
PARTIAL.action: 仅借鉴确实适用的部分；其余按专业摄影后期判断独立设计，记录适用范围。

PROFESSIONAL_FALLBACK.condition: 相关实例过少、缺少同类场景或光照、关键条件不符，或现有参考无法核验而不能形成有效匹配。
PROFESSIONAL_FALLBACK.action: 原片可访问时，直接依据专业摄影后期原则制定最适合该照片的风格、全局参数与局部精修方案，不强行匹配或套用现有母版/场景预设。

principles: 主动制定当前照片最有效的表达，既有Style DNA、天气、原光色和参考风格作为依据与素材，非审美硬边界
自由选择构图、光影、色彩、质感与局部精修，强度由实际结果决定
主体身份、关键文字及事实按用途保护，创意演绎与来源记录分开
不机械套同一种处理，不为大幅变化而强行加工；依据表达选择克制或大胆

style_matching_policy.user_facing_delivery: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
style_matching_policy.scope: 所有现行照片美化入口、日常EDIT、单张/批量、会话摘要与项目恢复。
style_matching_policy.persistent_style_update: 单张专业判断不自动改写长期核心，不自动新增授权参考，不修改既有固定预设数值。
style_matching_policy.professional_judgment_scope: All images and all evidence branches; references are optional resources, not aesthetic ceilings.
style_matching_policy.candidate_evidence: Scene intersection priority, then source_pixel_features_v1 relative tone/color distance using source-bound analysis features and frozen reference measurements. Up to 3 references; no minimum count or calibrated probability. Actual viewed selection with scope/material/light/expression reasons remains necessary; professional fallback for sparse or unsuitable evidence.

implementation.weights_basis: Engineering relative retrieval heuristic, not calibrated quality or semantic probability
implementation.cache: source SHA256 and feature algorithm version; rehash source before reuse and after calculation
implementation.reference_measurements: Read-only frozen measured_full in reference_index.json; not recomputed per edit
implementation.semantic_stage: Assistant actually views applicable returned references and compares light/material/intent, recorded by existing select; rank alone never selects or accepts
implementation.heavy_embeddings: OpenCLIP researched only; not installed or executed

semantic_retrieval.basis: Current visual observations supplied by assistant, compared with inferred index descriptions; no new model or full-library image reads
semantic_retrieval.ranking: metadata applicability before existing scene/tone/color shortlist; unknown intent keeps previous ordering
semantic_retrieval.limits: Not visual validation or aesthetic probability; no forced transfer or minimum examples

development_workflow.goal: 整合从原片制定风格与实际渲染、看图、针对问题修正的方法。

style_brief.rule: 先明确本次用途与表达意图，再写可观察的构图、光影、空间、色彩及材质关系，最后定参数；复用现有intent及终检。所有参考分支均适用。

execution_routes.native: 按目标选择实际可用路线；常规几何与调色可用原生工具，创意重塑可采用支持的生成编辑，不把单一工具范围作为审美上限。
execution_routes.lightroom: 仅在实际可用时读取设置并导出真实渲染预览；先发现当前工具，不假定所有文档功能存在。
execution_routes.alternative_engine: darktable/photo-xmp仅在实际可用且符合任务授权时使用；参数按引擎语义独立规划，不与Lightroom滑块直接等同。
execution_routes.jpeg: JPEG依据实际像素、ICC和细节直接处理，不要求补RAW。
execution_routes.raw: 最终RAW色彩判断使用同一RAW通过已知解码器和配置的真实渲染；相机JPEG只用于辅助选片和构图。
execution_routes.partial_capability: 完成可靠的已支持部分，记录未执行项；限制实质影响目标时简短说明。
execution_routes.no_renderer: 如实说明未完成，参数方案仅按需提供，不能称为成片。
execution_routes.protection: Select a real supported route that meets locked protection_policy; exact requirements cannot be reduced at acceptance.

render_review.baseline: 保留实际原片/技术基线、配方与输出关系。
render_review.first_pass: 普通照片先完成协调初稿并实际渲染；复杂或原因不明的问题分有界小步。
review: 在交付尺寸检查本次表达目标、完整表达及主体/环境关系
在实际原生分辨率检查受影响的文字、肤色、材质、渐变和蒙版边缘
render_review.revision: For a specific feedback target, correct that target and preserve the approved overall expression and other content. Compare against the actual source/reference, then inspect the target, transitions and whole-frame fit; no claim of unchanged outside pixels without a real preserving route.

invalidation.geometry: 更新坐标、蒙版和构图相关判断
invalidation.technical_color: 重检肤色、材质和创意色彩
invalidation.substantial_tone: 重检高光、色彩及参数蒙版

render_review.stop: 风格简报目标满足、实际执行核实且无已知未解决问题时结束。
render_review.limits: 无固定候选数或轮数，不为包装重复渲染；能力不足和未执行检查如实记录。
render_review.photographic_finish: Apply photographic_naturalness_policy during existing actual output review; preserve creative scope, register observed artifacts and recheck corrected areas.
render_review.artwork_preservation: Ordinary artwork/inscriptions: compare visible content to the original under protection_policy.artwork_default. No default per-stroke/OCR/external authenticity certification; concrete visible changes still require correction.
render_review.feedback_lineage: Editable jobs continue from the latest formally acquired/reviewed output. Accepted or terminal jobs require a new revision job linked to the user-selected result, original source and existing protection requirements; historical evidence stays immutable.

batch.transfer: 迁移主体表现、材质身份、明暗与色彩关系；逐张直接对照固定基准。
batch.delivery: 每张通过检查即可逐张交付。

development_workflow.adoption: 独立转写摄影决策和反馈方法，未复制或安装外部执行器；不引入仅限RAW、固定多轮确认或额外交付要求。

fast_edit_workflow.supersedes: 2026-10-24.1; general-purpose public defaults separated from private user preferences
fast_edit_workflow.goal: 减少上下文、临时脚本和记录往返；在局部操作前检查全局问题；保持全部视觉与来源验收。

canonical_context.validation: Verify five configuration SHA256 hashes plus master-document hash. Contract 3 binds project/revision/hashes at intake and rechecks current context at acceptance; stale jobs need new preparation and affected evidence. Completed historical records stay unchanged.
canonical_context.stale_skill: provider返回旧技能时使用已核验本地新版及现行规范；记录入口版本差异，不循环重读或声称已修复服务端缓存。
canonical_context.read_once: Reuse current rules already loaded for this task/conversation; verify bound revision/content hashes, reload changed or missing resources only. Canonical source bytes read once per bootstrap; acceptance still freshly revalidates current context. No metadata-only cross-task cache.
canonical_context.compact_bundle: PCS_Workflow_Runtime_Current.zip: controller plus verified configuration; reference photos fetched only as actually needed
canonical_context.photo_helper: 10_SYSTEM_CONFIG/scripts/photo_edit.py (preferred fused entrypoints), photo_workflow.py and style_match.py (compatible core; existing Pillow)
canonical_context.loading: 总规范和bootstrap每任务一次；专项指南只按实际任务读取，普通EDIT不预读所有修图手册。

execution.style: 每张均由专业摄影与艺术指导主动决定表达；MATCHED/PARTIAL/FALLBACK只是参考证据分支，不限制风格和强度。
execution.discovery: 选定执行路线后只发现该路线使用的参数；当前工具要求的预览必须保留。
execution.render: 协调首稿实际渲染；针对已发现问题修正；不为包装重复渲染、不合并已有非交换配方。
execution.task_resume: 已提交任务使用真实taskId续接；未知提交状态先核实，不自动重发。
execution.capture: 保留源哈希、配方或可复现指针、实际执行子集、真实输出哈希；DESIGNED与APPLIED分开。
execution.independent_work: Batch independent reads and prerequisites when known; reuse already loaded current text rather than rereading guides. Preparation follows actual source observation, submission follows actual adopted-reference observation, acceptance follows actual output review. Never fuse across these evidence boundaries.
execution.early_quality: 按所选路线确定依赖顺序；上游全局或几何输出先完成必要预览与检查，再生成依赖它的局部。RGB封顶等观测结合表达判断，因实际问题返工才重渲染。
execution.reusable_operations: photo_edit.prepare (intake/direction/candidates) -> actual reference observation -> submit (protect/select/issues/begin) -> actual external tool -> returned (finish/file check) -> actual full/detail review -> review (evidence/accept/optional snapshot). Each phase requires its actual dependencies.
execution.review_parallelism: 必要工具预览之后，独立的实际视觉检查与文件下载/数值检查可并行；验收依赖两者真实完成。源或几何变化重检受影响项。
execution.creative_scope: 按creative_direction_policy执行，不默认保守微调、全局滑块或保留原构图。
execution.reference_evidence: intent_metadata_v1 ranks observed subject/light/material/expression from index descriptions before scene/tone/color retrieval; metadata inference, not automatic vision/probability. Actual viewed scoped selection remains required
execution.photographic_finish: All routes apply photographic_naturalness_policy in style brief/actual recipe and existing real output review; no added stage, tool call or automatic visual pass.
execution.artwork_preservation: Apply protection_policy.artwork_default in the original brief/prompt and existing actual review; preserve what is visible, do not invent unclear lettering or auto-add exact per-stroke requirements.
execution.native_adjustment: Use actual non-generative tool capabilities for fidelity-critical light/color work, obtain formal output bytes, actual review and confirmed save; previews and URLs are not native-output completion. See 10_SYSTEM_CONFIG/NATIVE_ADJUSTMENT_ROUTE.md.
execution.external_adapter: Use execution_adapter_policy for all normal new calls, exact arguments, call receipt, protected regions and platform/manual separation

issue_acceptance.unit: 每项问题拆到明确目标，如clock与pier分别跟踪。
issue_acceptance.mask: 记录请求范围与实际选择范围；查看蒙版本身和边缘，bbox不是语义覆盖证明。蒙版绑定实际当前输入；几何或源输入变化后失效。
issue_acceptance.corrected: 记录最终输出哈希及该目标有效范围核验，修改后重查受影响区域。
issue_acceptance.not_needed: Observable reason and current final-output SHA256 required, no mask required. After actual review omission binds the latest reviewed output; without review provide explicit actually inspected hash. A different output invalidates the old conclusion.
issue_acceptance.accept: Contract 3 current-policy and master context, fresh source/output, actual visual/color passes and every target/reference/locked protection. Legacy contract 2 is historical; do not perform a new acceptance with it.
issue_acceptance.limitation: blocked必须以部分完成或能力限制记录并说明实质影响；不伪称完整验收。
issue_acceptance.protection: Lock protection before rendering. Ordinary artwork/inscriptions use semantic_identity with visible-source consistency; exact_content only for explicit strict or archival need. Every protected target needs actual current-output comparison evidence. Do not fail solely for source illegibility or absent per-stroke certification, and do not ignore observed edits. No acceptance-time weakening of existing contracts.
issue_acceptance.photographic_finish: visual_passed includes credible photographic texture and coherent light/geometry. Record observed artificial artifacts as targeted issues; unresolved material artifacts or uncertain affected detail cannot be a complete pass.

retrieval.implementation: urllib transport; temporary file; full Pillow decode, format/dimensions/color declaration and optional SHA256 before atomic replacement. Inspection needs existing Pillow; no implicit installation.
retrieval.failure: 失败保留既有目标文件、报告具体原因；无requests依赖和任意重试循环。
retrieval.formal_local_output: Attach the actual returned local file without copying, downloading or reuploading generated imagery merely for display/save

timing.clock: Unix timestamps for boundaries; monotonic durations for local measured operations; actual external wall boundaries explicitly labelled.
timing.tools: 调用起止、名称、结果；同时报告调用时长总和与区间并集，重叠不重复计入占用时间。
timing.comparison: 冷启动、缓存复测、增量修正分别标记；不同范围不计算提速倍数。
timing.scope: 不将本地规划、工具返回时长、云端渲染或最终保存混为整体耗时。
timing.coverage: Observed photo-save or failed/cancelled endpoint enables clipped union and unattributed gaps; overlapping stage/tool intervals not double-counted; missing stages remain null.
timing.save: Manual uses intent and actual save receipt; platform_auto uses only authoritative post-commit evidence when available. No receipt means null save endpoint, never wait/reupload or infer automatic completion
timing.record: Final archive only after confirmed persistence; pending platform snapshot explicitly pending_platform_confirmation. Historical times and absent callbacks are not invented
timing.external: stage records actually observed context/diagnosis/upload/render/download/visual/save boundaries; never label receipt-write time as visual review or API wall time as backend compute
timing.failure: finish records actual failed/cancelled endpoint and reason, no save/accept milestone. Terminal jobs are immutable; continuation uses a new task. Failed local spans live in source+start bound .timing.json sidecar to preserve rejected-operation ledger atomicity.

fast_edit_workflow.delivery: Follow user_facing_delivery and execution_adapter_policy; default one final photograph only, with actual scoped quality and platform/manual status separately recorded

automation.mode: Assistant-led autonomous workflow with actual professional visual review; no new user approval gate
automation.entrypoint: prepare current context is authoritative; observed old skill revision is diagnostic, never hard-code it as expected revision. entry for separate recovery only. Provider cache refresh is not claimed.
automation.render: Persist submission before call; exact task continuation; reviewed/acquired current step may next-render with archived lineage. No retry disguised as a new step.
automation.fetch: Fetch formal bytes once, hash-bound reuse, at most one bounded transfer retry; never rerender for download failure
automation.save: Unknown/failed save receipts investigated without automatic duplicate writes. Actual photo receipt → idempotent complete and compact final record → bound record intent → actual record receipt → DELIVER.
automation.review: Existing actual whole/native detail, color, issue and protection checks remain; controller never creates a visual pass
automation.history: Failed/cancelled jobs immutable; source or context drift needs new preparation. Completed historical evidence unchanged.
automation.delivery: Display, quality and persistence tracked separately. DELIVER denotes confirmed archive, not the earlier mandatory tool presentation. Platform pending snapshots are not final records

professional_direction.priority: Visual intent, hierarchy, light and material compatibility precede reference color distance; professional fallback immediately when no suitable reference
professional_direction.freedom: No fixed aesthetic, crop, technique or strength cap. Native/creative/hybrid as justified by the photograph; naturalness and source content protections retained
professional_direction.multi_step: direction before first submission; next-render only from current formally acquired, visually/profile reviewed output. Retain prior receipts; current output/input must match final acceptance
professional_direction.qa: Whole frame always; native detail of affected/protected/edge areas; expand if anomalies. No mandatory large crop/report bundle on ordinary EDIT
professional_direction.output_scope: Screen default; print proof and RAW/skin/batch reliability require actual task-specific evidence, never inferred from one example or ICC presence

expressive_finish.user_instruction: 我希望表达的明显更充分
expressive_finish.default: Professional photographic and art direction actively resolve composition, hierarchy, light, color and material for the current task; conservative micro-adjustment is not the default endpoint.
expressive_finish.review: Within existing actual visual review, compare source/current result and applicable task reference at delivery scale. Technical/file/content checks do not establish expressive completion. Record achieved relationships and concrete aesthetic issues, then revise unresolved issues without automatic numeric scoring.
expressive_finish.naturalness: Photographic credibility and expressive completion apply together. Naturalness is reviewed in the selected expression; it imposes no muted palette, low exposure, weak contrast, unchanged framing or conservative strength cap.
expressive_finish.freedom: No forced warm gold, saturation, contrast, edit amount or candidate/iteration count. Deliberate restraint may pass with actual photographic reasons
expressive_finish.reference: Explicit current user reference takes priority for suitable visual relationships, no mandatory generic reference detour and no automatic catalog import

creative_direction_policy.user_instruction: Professional direction with broad creative freedom
creative_direction_policy.principle: 以每张照片的用途、当次用户要求和最有效的视觉表达为目标，摄影与艺术指导统筹构图、光影、色彩、空间与材质；不预设统一风格、曝光、色调或改动强度。
creative_direction_policy.priority: Current explicit purpose and protected information, then this creative direction; frozen Style DNA, references, scene recipes and aesthetic prohibitions are advisory resources.
creative_direction_policy.professional_judgment: Every photo, including MATCHED and PARTIAL, receives independent professional direction. Fallback means insufficient reference evidence, not the only route allowed independent judgment.

degrees_of_freedom.composition: 自由保留、优化或重构；裁切、比例、方向、透视、局部抽象、视觉主体与必要扩图按表达决定，无固定改动幅度。
degrees_of_freedom.tone_and_light: 自由选择高调、低调、反差、明暗主次、局部塑光、光线重塑及创意日夜氛围；不以原始亮度、自然光方向或统一深黑为审美硬约束。
degrees_of_freedom.color: 自由设计白平衡、冷暖、色相、饱和度、分级、黑白与鲜明风格；原有低饱和、自然色或旧Style DNA不构成限制。
degrees_of_freedom.finish: 按目的采用曲线、分区色彩、局部明暗、质感、锐化、降噪、虚实、光晕、颗粒与材质风格化，强度由实际效果决定。
degrees_of_freedom.creative_content: 允许符合表达的扩图、非关键干扰清理、背景与氛围整理及非核心元素重排；生成、移除、重排和光照/天气演绎记录为创意改动，不冒充拍摄事实。
degrees_of_freedom.tools: 按表达、真实能力与输出质量选路线；不将全局滑块、某个软件或单一引擎作为固定范围。实际生成编辑遵守imagegen等对应技能，引用原片并核验输出。

decision_rules.stop: 完成表达、构图、主次光影、色彩与材质/细节判断，实际渲染和质量复核通过后结束；全局调整若已足够可结束，须有针对本片的判断依据。

protected_information.documentary: 纪实、证据、档案任务按其真实性要求处理；普通创意照片允许光色与氛围演绎，真实拍摄元数据和事实记录保持准确。
protected_information.identity_or_key_fact_change: 需要当次明确的相应创作意图；广泛审美自由不自动授权改变身份、作品关键信息或事件事实。

forbidden: 虚构EXIF、作者参数、能力、已执行操作或检查结果
把画中画或不合格参考当作有效肤色标定
将待修图或成片自动加入授权参考库
将生成或创意演绎内容冒充已核实拍摄事实
execution_integrity.quality: 实际预览、原生细节、色彩管理、来源链和逐目标复核继续执行；高光封顶、深黑、颗粒或风格化色彩是需结合表达判断的观测，不能仅凭阈值否决有意表达。

creative_direction_policy.delivery: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
creative_direction_policy.efficiency: 主规范与源哈希每任务核验一次，详细指南按需加载；通过复用、并行和精简记录提速，不以微调或省略必要后期换速度。
creative_direction_policy.numerical_assets: Frozen presets, reference photos and legacy DNA remain unchanged as optional resources; live creative policy supersedes their aesthetic constraints.

soft_low_key.role: Optional expressive reference, not a global editing default or fixed preset.
soft_low_key.selection: Use when the current user reference/intent or actual photographic direction selects it; evaluate each scene independently.
soft_low_key.relationships: Restrained highlights, legible subject layers within deep shadows, soft transitions and scene-appropriate color; no obligatory brown tint, neutral saturation or preserved framing.
soft_low_key.transfer: Transfer suitable light/tone relationships, not reference objects, marks or surface texture.

workflow_update_policy.user_instruction: 之后进行调整增加链路环节完成之后要进行整个链路的整合和提升
workflow_update_policy.trigger: Every system/workflow rule adjustment, addition, removal or reordering of a stage
workflow_update_policy.scope: System maintenance only; ordinary per-photo EDIT does not repeat system maintenance
steps: 确认变更目标、影响范围和现行基线，保留可回溯版本。
将变化合并进现行总链路，替换冲突旧规则；统一入口、判断、执行、验收、保存、交付，不持续叠加互相覆盖的补丁。
贯穿完整链路检查前后依赖、输入输出、源与配置哈希、缓存失效、几何/蒙版依赖、任务状态与恢复入口。
清理重复读取、无效工具发现、重复渲染和保存，复用已验证资源并并行独立步骤；保持所需后期深度、实际预览和质量复核。
执行与改动类型相符的整体连通及受影响分支回归，检查来源、真实输出、逐目标验收和恢复包一致性；未执行的分支明确标记。
复评响应速度与质量，以真实端到端或相同范围证据比较；本地检查、文本大小、工具区间和云端时间分别表述。
同步总规范、技能、机器政策、摘要及需要更新的执行/恢复包，保存验证和效率结论后才将本次系统更新标为完成。

validation_scope.rules_or_documentation_only: 核验规则一致性、源摘要、模块接口和恢复链路；按需运行本地回归，不为纯维护条文强制重复云端出图。
validation_scope.image_execution_change: 实际涉及图像判断、执行、蒙版、几何或保存行为变化时，用真实原片验证相应执行路径，实际看图及记录真实保存结果。
validation_scope.coverage: 整体连通、局部回归、离线复放和真实出图分别标明；不以局部通过宣称所有云端/全场景通过。

unsupported_claims: 将文本减少直接称为等比例响应提速
将本地复放当作完整云端出图
将未归因间隙称为已测模型或云端耗时
无完整证据宣称达到最高效率
efficiency_review.no_runtime_overhead_by_default: 维护细则只在系统更新时展开；不新增日常修图的询问、批准、报告、全套测试或重复工具调用。

workflow_update_policy.ordinary_photo_delivery_unchanged: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；当次明确要求优先，内部对照与实际质量复核保留。
workflow_update_policy.guide_synchronization: Synchronize current guide header revisions and existing entrypoint/skill/config mirrors during maintenance; executable examples bind current context instead of pinning a historical workflow revision.

color_delivery_policy.declarations: Inspect ICC header/tag bounds and pixel model; description is display only. Canonical sRGB uses characterization tags, unknown valid ICC retains fingerprint. PNG effective precedence cICP > iCCP > sRGB > cHRM/gAMA; distinguish declared, unsupported, invalid, same-level conflict and unknown. Unsupported is never eligible for an untagged sRGB assumption.
color_delivery_policy.originals: Preserve original source and original generated bytes. Do not copy the original photograph profile onto unrelated generated pixels.
color_delivery_policy.known_output: Preserve a correct declaration, or perform a real color-managed conversion for the delivery target. Metadata assignment is not gamut conversion.
color_delivery_policy.untagged_web_output: Ordinary 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG screen delivery may explicitly use screen_srgb_assumed with source encoding still unknown and profile_passed=false; only a separately required tagged deliverable uses existing documented metadata-only export. Never relabel known P3/HDR/invalid declarations
color_delivery_policy.metadata_only_export: Static 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG; no gamut conversion; decoded pixels/IDAT unchanged. Preflight and stage image plus receipt; no-clobber publication; on failure remove only owned new inodes. Explicit resume_existing=true may complete a missing receipt only when existing output is byte-identical to deterministic export. No generic overwrite.
color_delivery_policy.scope: review inspects actual output; accept re-hashes source/output and reuses exact-hash inspection (pixels and metadata) while cross-checking scope. Explicit or omitted scope cannot upgrade assumptions. managed is declared interpretation, not calibration.
color_delivery_policy.strict_output: For print, archive, calibrated comparison or confirmed wide-gamut delivery, unknown output encoding remains unverified until established. Do not bypass this by labelling or re-rendering blindly.
color_delivery_policy.efficiency: Inspect declarations within the existing file check. Invoke metadata-only export only when required; no additional model call, duplicate reference lookup, daily system suite or extra approval.
color_delivery_policy.platform_screen_scope: For ordinary screen use only, explicitly assumed untagged 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG may use screen_srgb_assumed with reason and profile_passed=false; not managed/source-certified/print-ready. Existing invalid, unsupported, P3 or HDR declarations cannot use this route

levels.semantic_identity: Protect specified visible content/recognizable identity against the actual source; ordinary artwork lettering uses visible-source consistency, not independent transcription or per-stroke certification.
levels.exact_content: Exact glyph/stroke/identity constraints; any known protected-content recreation fails, uncertainty stays unverified.

protection_policy.contract: set_protections once before first_render/reviews; explicit empty list needs a reason. A stricter instruction in the render prompt belongs in this contract.
protection_policy.route: Compare required protection against real current capabilities before execution; route must support it. No available reliable route means limited result, not a full pass. Do not assume native or generation can guarantee fidelity.
protection_policy.acceptance: Latest per-target evidence binds current output hash, comparison method, met/failed/unverified and content_recreated boolean. Neither issue closure nor a disclaimer replaces unmet protection.
protection_policy.historical: Preserve original acceptance snapshots; dated amendments state current limited assessment without inventing historical reviews or times.

artwork_default.user_instruction: 这类书画题字问题保持与原图一致即可
artwork_default.scope: 普通后期中的书画、题字、匾额、印章及其画中细节；以本次实际原图为唯一内容基准。
artwork_default.preserve: 对照保留原图可见文字内容、字形/笔触关系、印章形状/位置、画作主要内容与布局；允许按表达调整光影、色彩和构图，不借调色改字、补字、删字、换印章或重新解释可见作品内容。
artwork_default.source_ambiguity: 原图模糊、遮挡或难辨的部分保留其原有状态，不凭空补清、不猜写。无法独立辨读/OCR或未逐笔鉴定本身不构成失败；实际发现内容差异或关键可见内容被遮掩、改写/无法比较时针对该处保留问题。
artwork_default.review: 在已有全幅及受影响原生细节复核中对照实际原图，记录可观察差异；不做默认外部释读、作者/真伪考证、每字转录、逐笔认证或像素完全相等证明。来源本就不可辨不等于后期引入错误。
artwork_default.failure: 实际改字、增删、明显笔触/印章/画作内容变形或重绘改变可见信息时针对性修正；无依据的无法保证不得替代具体问题，也不能忽略已观察差异。
artwork_default.strict_opt_in: 仅当用户明确要求逐笔/像素级保真，或纪实证据/档案任务确需严格复制时渲染前选择exact_content，并明确范围；普通书画照片不自动升级。
artwork_default.prompt: 按原图保留书画题字和印章的可见内容及布局，原本模糊处保持；只做所需摄影处理。不要自行追加逐笔/逐像素完全相同的契约。
artwork_default.historical: 新规则用于新任务；既有锁定契约和测试历史保持，不靠降低旧任务条件把失败改写为通过。

protection_policy.execution_scope_review: Plan per-target visible regions before rendering; actual generated protected-content comparison records comparison_scope and content_recreated. No new per-stroke certification, no waived exact_content

photographic_naturalness_policy.user_instruction: 需要保持去ai味这一条规则
photographic_naturalness_policy.scope: Every photo, MATCHED/PARTIAL/PROFESSIONAL_FALLBACK, native and generative tools, single and batch edits.
photographic_naturalness_policy.goal: 去AI味：成片具有可信的摄影质感、自然且自洽的空间和细节；创作自由与本质量要求同时生效。
checks: 光源方向、阴影、反射、透视和景深在选定表达中自洽，避免无依据的局部发光、抠贴感和失真的虚化。
皮肤、纸张、木石、瓦片、植被和水面保留可信材质及不规则细节；消除塑料感、蜡化、涂抹、重复贴图、凭空补出的假纹理和过锐白边。
人物、建筑结构、物件边缘及文字印章检查可见变形和接缝；普通书画题字按与原图可见内容一致复核，不因无法独立辨读或未做逐笔认证自动否决。实际改写/增删/明显重绘差异继续修正；去AI味不替代保真。
色彩和明暗层次有表达依据，避免机械橙青、无依据统一偏色、HDR光晕和局部平滑断层；细腻或强烈风格均须看实际结果。
photographic_naturalness_policy.creative_compatibility: 充分表达与可信摄影质感同时落实；自然度不为既有构图、强烈调色、黑白、颗粒、虚实、塑光或材质风格化预设保守强度上限。普通摄影中的无意材质失真按原片修正；明确选定的材质转译或非摄影媒介按当次表达评价并记录，不增设批准。
photographic_naturalness_policy.execution: 方向简报与实际提示/配方包含摄影质感要求；提示词或参数不证明已达标。嵌入已有交付尺寸和原生细节复核，不新增独立工具调用、批准、固定候选或轮数。
photographic_naturalness_policy.acceptance: Existing visual_passed includes actual photographic-naturalness review of the current hashed output. Register observed artifacts as targeted issues, correct and recheck affected areas; unresolved/uncertain material artifacts remain failed or unverified/limited. Never auto-generate a visual pass from a config flag or detector score.
photographic_naturalness_policy.record: Use existing style brief, actual recipe/prompt, review note and targeted issue evidence; state observed defects and correction or uncertainty. No extra mandatory report or fabricated AI-likeness score.
photographic_naturalness_policy.provenance: Keep actual source and tool/generative-operation records; reducing visual artifacts does not erase provenance or certify that no AI was used.
photographic_naturalness_policy.historical: Do not retroactively certify earlier images without a real review under this criterion.

material_finish.ordinary_photographic_edit: Use the observed source material identity, surface coarseness and visible embossing as the basis. Build tactile depth with light, tonal separation and reflections; more texture does not automatically mean coarser, sharper or clearer detail.
material_finish.source_information: Do not invent unobserved spots, rust, fibers or engraving to demonstrate texture. Keep ambiguous detail ambiguous; generated detail is not recovered capture information.
material_finish.intentional_stylization: When the selected expression intentionally translates material or uses a non-photographic medium, apply existing creative authorization, record the interpretation and retain identity/key-information protections. No added approval or strength ceiling.

execution_adapter_policy.scope: Normal new EDIT tasks; legacy low-level interfaces remain protocol/history compatibility
execution_adapter_policy.submission: begin persists actual arguments, their digest, source, protected review regions and submission_id before one real tool call; finish atomically binds exact formal local output or real URL and actual caller-observed timing
execution_adapter_policy.display: Observed tool presentation is not quality approval or persistence; mandatory platform display cannot be gated or hidden by policy

modes.manual: Accept scoped quality, bind save intent, use real photo-save receipt then final record and its save
modes.platform_auto: Observe presentation, review formal returned bytes, accept only the actual output-use scope; no real platform receipt means pending_confirmation. Archive a pending snapshot and end the turn without polling, duplicate rendering, upload or redisplay

execution_adapter_policy.platform_receipt: Only independently available authoritative evidence binding exact output SHA and saved Library identity confirms persistence. A provider-supplied invocation id must match, but a provider need not know the local UUID. No background callback/scheduler is installed; an expected automatic save is not evidence.
execution_adapter_policy.color: For ordinary screen use only, explicitly assumed untagged 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG may use screen_srgb_assumed with reason and profile_passed=false; not managed/source-certified/print-ready. Existing invalid, unsupported, P3 or HDR declarations cannot use this route
execution_adapter_policy.protected_content: Plan per-target visible regions before rendering; actual generated protected-content comparison records comparison_scope and content_recreated. No new per-stroke certification, no waived exact_content
execution_adapter_policy.trace: Exact actual parameters/prompt; formal byte hash; submission; result; observed call start/end. No base64, invented times or unsupported reproducibility claims
execution_adapter_policy.refinement: next-step uses latest acquired and actually reviewed bytes; working polls exact task, unknown/error investigates without resubmission
execution_adapter_policy.maintenance: sync_entrypoints derives policy mirrors, thin navigation, skill guides/hash manifest and SESSION_BRIEF; no per-photo maintenance run
execution_adapter_policy.validation: Distinguish synthetic protocol, real-image replay, live generation and actual platform save receipt. Never relabel replay or fixture identity as production evidence

lean_execution.prepare: One local call binds intake context/source, explicit photographic direction and candidate retrieval; returns compact candidate evidence and master hash, not full policy or image histograms.
lean_execution.submit: One atomic ledger operation records explicit protection/reference/issue decisions and reserves actual tool arguments. It does not call the external tool or supply visual decisions.
lean_execution.returned: One local call attaches the real tool result and checks available formal local bytes. URL-only results still require formal acquisition through existing adapter; no fake ready file.
lean_execution.review: One local call applies explicit actually observed evidence, runs unchanged acceptance gates, then optionally creates an internal snapshot. Snapshot failure is recoverable after acceptance; the two writes are not claimed atomic.
lean_execution.inspection_reuse: Reuse formal-output inspection only when current resolved path, actual SHA256 of all bytes and INSPECTION_VERSION match. Changed pixels, metadata or inspector version force fresh decode. Geometry/masks, color scope, source/current context, issues/protection and actual visual review are still checked.
lean_execution.reading: Read canonical bytes once per bootstrap and reuse loaded current instruction text within the task. Do not infer remote freshness from local mtime, indefinitely cache policies, or skip final current-context hashes.
lean_execution.response: Compact receipts only; keep complete actual parameters, file proof and decisions in the job. Inspect full job only for a concrete diagnostic need.
lean_execution.timing: Measure actual local operations and actual external-call boundaries. Decode/response reduction is not proof of cloud or end-to-end acceleration; no fixed speed promise.

review_input_contract.preflight: Validate all event shapes/signatures, comparison_scope list covering planned regions, and actual_scope list containing the exact target ID before any ledger transaction. Return field/hint JSON errors; never normalize a descriptive string into a passed receipt.
review_input_contract.return_hints: returned includes compact review_requirements with planned region strings and issue target IDs; these are structural hints, not visual judgments.
review_input_contract.prepare: Publish a new task atomically only after direction/candidate preparation succeeds; existing paths never overwritten.

fidelity_strategy.planning: Normal daily submit requires one explicit strategy/capability_basis/repair_route for every protected target. Native preservation or local exclusion where actually supported; generative_compare is permitted for ordinary semantic_identity with real comparison and correction.
fidelity_strategy.strict: Reject exact_content plus generative_compare before external submission; do not weaken the requirement. Native/local preservation plans cannot accept content_recreated=true.
fidelity_strategy.limits: No prompt-only preservation guarantee, no invented native tool capabilities, no automatic OCR/per-stroke certification. Actual visible-content mismatch must be corrected or remain blocked; subjective visual checks remain necessary.

quality_observations.capture: prepare explicitly labels evaluation_kind and scenario; default unclassified. Existing snapshot automatically includes quality_observation; review returns a compact sample, no separate daily tool or save.
quality_observations.report: Explicit job/record paths only. Deduplicate source SHA+job start+revision, reject conflicting snapshots; group live/replay/synthetic/unclassified and report unique sources/scenarios. Caller-declared live plus actual receipts is trace evidence, not an independent quality rating.
quality_observations.metrics: First output acceptance over known recorded quality outcomes; deliberate image revisions separately from validation failures. Polls of one submission do not inflate render counts. External-call median and receipt-confirmed photo-save elapsed reported separately, missing values null.
quality_observations.claims: No stable-quality percentage inferred from small samples; synthetic/replay excluded from live rates, same-source repetitions not independent scenes, no guessed platform-save or cloud compute time.

input_references.capture: Automatically hash each actual local referenced_image_paths file before submit and deliberate next-step; store exact resolved path, SHA256 and role alongside actual tool arguments.
input_references.roles: Optional adapter input_references [{path,role}] maps actual attached paths to edit_target/style_reference/composition_reference/identity_reference/supporting_reference. Unspecified extra files remain supporting_reference; no visual role inference.
input_references.verify: Fresh-state and final acceptance verify current reference bytes; mismatch requires investigation of the existing submission, never blind resubmission.
input_references.scope: Remote/conversation inputs without local bytes remain explicitly not locally hash-bound. Existing source and content protections remain effective.
input_references.overhead: Existing submit/result/review calls only; no new approval, image render, report or daily stage.

download_safety.destination: Reject any existing path, including dangling symlinks, before I/O; publish through an exclusive same-directory link to reject races. Unsupported exclusive publication fails safely.
download_safety.format: Validate decoded PNG/JPEG against a nonempty destination suffix; reject mismatch without reencoding or overwriting. Preserve provider bytes and provenance.

style_matching_policy.user_instruction: 要求匹配出最适合当前上传照片的风格；库中实例过少导致匹配失效时，从专业摄影师的角度判断并处理照片的后期风格。
style_matching_policy.goal: 为当前原片选择最适合其光照、主体、材质与表达目的的后期风格。
style_matching_policy.assessment: 先看实际原片，按相关性与证据支持范围判断；参考总量或固定张数不构成有效匹配门槛。
criteria: 用户当次要求与表达目的
光照方向、软硬与自然光/人工光结构
主体类型与材质、肤色保护需求
实际场景与天气
色彩关系与冷暖结构
影调、反差及可保留的细节
构图与空间层次

MATCHED.condition: 存在能支持当前照片主要风格决策的适用参考。
MATCHED.action: 选择最适合的参考，转译其有效光色关系，并按原片调整；不直接复制绝对曝光、白平衡或整套参数。

PARTIAL.condition: 参考只支持部分区域、材质或光色关系，整体场景证据不足。
PARTIAL.action: 仅借鉴确实适用的部分；其余按专业摄影后期判断独立设计，记录适用范围。

PROFESSIONAL_FALLBACK.condition: 相关实例过少、缺少同类场景或光照、关键条件不符，或现有参考无法核验而不能形成有效匹配。
PROFESSIONAL_FALLBACK.action: 原片可访问时，直接依据专业摄影后期原则制定最适合该照片的风格、全局参数与局部精修方案，不强行匹配或套用现有母版/场景预设。

principles: 主动制定当前照片最有效的表达，既有Style DNA、天气、原光色和参考风格作为依据与素材，非审美硬边界
自由选择构图、光影、色彩、质感与局部精修，强度由实际结果决定
主体身份、关键文字及事实按用途保护，创意演绎与来源记录分开
不机械套同一种处理，不为大幅变化而强行加工；依据表达选择克制或大胆

style_matching_policy.user_facing_delivery: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
style_matching_policy.scope: 所有现行照片美化入口、日常EDIT、单张/批量、会话摘要与项目恢复。
style_matching_policy.persistent_style_update: 单张专业判断不自动改写长期核心，不自动新增授权参考，不修改既有固定预设数值。
style_matching_policy.professional_judgment_scope: All images and all evidence branches; references are optional resources, not aesthetic ceilings.
style_matching_policy.candidate_evidence: Scene intersection priority, then source_pixel_features_v1 relative tone/color distance using source-bound analysis features and frozen reference measurements. Up to 3 references; no minimum count or calibrated probability. Actual viewed selection with scope/material/light/expression reasons remains necessary; professional fallback for sparse or unsuitable evidence.

implementation.weights_basis: Engineering relative retrieval heuristic, not calibrated quality or semantic probability
implementation.cache: source SHA256 and feature algorithm version; rehash source before reuse and after calculation
implementation.reference_measurements: Read-only frozen measured_full in reference_index.json; not recomputed per edit
implementation.semantic_stage: Assistant actually views applicable returned references and compares light/material/intent, recorded by existing select; rank alone never selects or accepts
implementation.heavy_embeddings: OpenCLIP researched only; not installed or executed

semantic_retrieval.basis: Current visual observations supplied by assistant, compared with inferred index descriptions; no new model or full-library image reads
semantic_retrieval.ranking: metadata applicability before existing scene/tone/color shortlist; unknown intent keeps previous ordering
semantic_retrieval.limits: Not visual validation or aesthetic probability; no forced transfer or minimum examples

development_workflow.goal: 整合从原片制定风格与实际渲染、看图、针对问题修正的方法。

style_brief.rule: 先明确本次用途与表达意图，再写可观察的构图、光影、空间、色彩及材质关系，最后定参数；复用现有intent及终检。所有参考分支均适用。

execution_routes.native: 按目标选择实际可用路线；常规几何与调色可用原生工具，创意重塑可采用支持的生成编辑，不把单一工具范围作为审美上限。
execution_routes.lightroom: 仅在实际可用时读取设置并导出真实渲染预览；先发现当前工具，不假定所有文档功能存在。
execution_routes.alternative_engine: darktable/photo-xmp仅在实际可用且符合任务授权时使用；参数按引擎语义独立规划，不与Lightroom滑块直接等同。
execution_routes.jpeg: JPEG依据实际像素、ICC和细节直接处理，不要求补RAW。
execution_routes.raw: 最终RAW色彩判断使用同一RAW通过已知解码器和配置的真实渲染；相机JPEG只用于辅助选片和构图。
execution_routes.partial_capability: 完成可靠的已支持部分，记录未执行项；限制实质影响目标时简短说明。
execution_routes.no_renderer: 如实说明未完成，参数方案仅按需提供，不能称为成片。
execution_routes.protection: Select a real supported route that meets locked protection_policy; exact requirements cannot be reduced at acceptance.

render_review.baseline: 保留实际原片/技术基线、配方与输出关系。
render_review.first_pass: 普通照片先完成协调初稿并实际渲染；复杂或原因不明的问题分有界小步。
review: 在交付尺寸检查本次表达目标、完整表达及主体/环境关系
在实际原生分辨率检查受影响的文字、肤色、材质、渐变和蒙版边缘
render_review.revision: For a specific feedback target, correct that target and preserve the approved overall expression and other content. Compare against the actual source/reference, then inspect the target, transitions and whole-frame fit; no claim of unchanged outside pixels without a real preserving route.

invalidation.geometry: 更新坐标、蒙版和构图相关判断
invalidation.technical_color: 重检肤色、材质和创意色彩
invalidation.substantial_tone: 重检高光、色彩及参数蒙版

render_review.stop: 风格简报目标满足、实际执行核实且无已知未解决问题时结束。
render_review.limits: 无固定候选数或轮数，不为包装重复渲染；能力不足和未执行检查如实记录。
render_review.photographic_finish: Apply photographic_naturalness_policy during existing actual output review; preserve creative scope, register observed artifacts and recheck corrected areas.
render_review.artwork_preservation: Ordinary artwork/inscriptions: compare visible content to the original under protection_policy.artwork_default. No default per-stroke/OCR/external authenticity certification; concrete visible changes still require correction.
render_review.feedback_lineage: Editable jobs continue from the latest formally acquired/reviewed output. Accepted or terminal jobs require a new revision job linked to the user-selected result, original source and existing protection requirements; historical evidence stays immutable.

batch.transfer: 迁移主体表现、材质身份、明暗与色彩关系；逐张直接对照固定基准。
batch.delivery: 每张通过检查即可逐张交付。

development_workflow.adoption: 独立转写摄影决策和反馈方法，未复制或安装外部执行器；不引入仅限RAW、固定多轮确认或额外交付要求。

fast_edit_workflow.supersedes: 2026-10-24.1; general-purpose public defaults separated from private user preferences
fast_edit_workflow.goal: 减少上下文、临时脚本和记录往返；在局部操作前检查全局问题；保持全部视觉与来源验收。

canonical_context.validation: Verify five configuration SHA256 hashes plus master-document hash. Contract 3 binds project/revision/hashes at intake and rechecks current context at acceptance; stale jobs need new preparation and affected evidence. Completed historical records stay unchanged.
canonical_context.stale_skill: provider返回旧技能时使用已核验本地新版及现行规范；记录入口版本差异，不循环重读或声称已修复服务端缓存。
canonical_context.read_once: Reuse current rules already loaded for this task/conversation; verify bound revision/content hashes, reload changed or missing resources only. Canonical source bytes read once per bootstrap; acceptance still freshly revalidates current context. No metadata-only cross-task cache.
canonical_context.compact_bundle: PCS_Workflow_Runtime_Current.zip: controller plus verified configuration; reference photos fetched only as actually needed
canonical_context.photo_helper: 10_SYSTEM_CONFIG/scripts/photo_edit.py (preferred fused entrypoints), photo_workflow.py and style_match.py (compatible core; existing Pillow)
canonical_context.loading: 总规范和bootstrap每任务一次；专项指南只按实际任务读取，普通EDIT不预读所有修图手册。

execution.style: 每张均由专业摄影与艺术指导主动决定表达；MATCHED/PARTIAL/FALLBACK只是参考证据分支，不限制风格和强度。
execution.discovery: 选定执行路线后只发现该路线使用的参数；当前工具要求的预览必须保留。
execution.render: 协调首稿实际渲染；针对已发现问题修正；不为包装重复渲染、不合并已有非交换配方。
execution.task_resume: 已提交任务使用真实taskId续接；未知提交状态先核实，不自动重发。
execution.capture: 保留源哈希、配方或可复现指针、实际执行子集、真实输出哈希；DESIGNED与APPLIED分开。
execution.independent_work: Batch independent reads and prerequisites when known; reuse already loaded current text rather than rereading guides. Preparation follows actual source observation, submission follows actual adopted-reference observation, acceptance follows actual output review. Never fuse across these evidence boundaries.
execution.early_quality: 按所选路线确定依赖顺序；上游全局或几何输出先完成必要预览与检查，再生成依赖它的局部。RGB封顶等观测结合表达判断，因实际问题返工才重渲染。
execution.reusable_operations: photo_edit.prepare (intake/direction/candidates) -> actual reference observation -> submit (protect/select/issues/begin) -> actual external tool -> returned (finish/file check) -> actual full/detail review -> review (evidence/accept/optional snapshot). Each phase requires its actual dependencies.
execution.review_parallelism: 必要工具预览之后，独立的实际视觉检查与文件下载/数值检查可并行；验收依赖两者真实完成。源或几何变化重检受影响项。
execution.creative_scope: 按creative_direction_policy执行，不默认保守微调、全局滑块或保留原构图。
execution.reference_evidence: intent_metadata_v1 ranks observed subject/light/material/expression from index descriptions before scene/tone/color retrieval; metadata inference, not automatic vision/probability. Actual viewed scoped selection remains required
execution.photographic_finish: All routes apply photographic_naturalness_policy in style brief/actual recipe and existing real output review; no added stage, tool call or automatic visual pass.
execution.artwork_preservation: Apply protection_policy.artwork_default in the original brief/prompt and existing actual review; preserve what is visible, do not invent unclear lettering or auto-add exact per-stroke requirements.
execution.native_adjustment: Use actual non-generative tool capabilities for fidelity-critical light/color work, obtain formal output bytes, actual review and confirmed save; previews and URLs are not native-output completion. See 10_SYSTEM_CONFIG/NATIVE_ADJUSTMENT_ROUTE.md.
execution.external_adapter: Use execution_adapter_policy for all normal new calls, exact arguments, call receipt, protected regions and platform/manual separation

issue_acceptance.unit: 每项问题拆到明确目标，如clock与pier分别跟踪。
issue_acceptance.mask: 记录请求范围与实际选择范围；查看蒙版本身和边缘，bbox不是语义覆盖证明。蒙版绑定实际当前输入；几何或源输入变化后失效。
issue_acceptance.corrected: 记录最终输出哈希及该目标有效范围核验，修改后重查受影响区域。
issue_acceptance.not_needed: Observable reason and current final-output SHA256 required, no mask required. After actual review omission binds the latest reviewed output; without review provide explicit actually inspected hash. A different output invalidates the old conclusion.
issue_acceptance.accept: Contract 3 current-policy and master context, fresh source/output, actual visual/color passes and every target/reference/locked protection. Legacy contract 2 is historical; do not perform a new acceptance with it.
issue_acceptance.limitation: blocked必须以部分完成或能力限制记录并说明实质影响；不伪称完整验收。
issue_acceptance.protection: Lock protection before rendering. Ordinary artwork/inscriptions use semantic_identity with visible-source consistency; exact_content only for explicit strict or archival need. Every protected target needs actual current-output comparison evidence. Do not fail solely for source illegibility or absent per-stroke certification, and do not ignore observed edits. No acceptance-time weakening of existing contracts.
issue_acceptance.photographic_finish: visual_passed includes credible photographic texture and coherent light/geometry. Record observed artificial artifacts as targeted issues; unresolved material artifacts or uncertain affected detail cannot be a complete pass.

retrieval.implementation: urllib transport; temporary file; full Pillow decode, format/dimensions/color declaration and optional SHA256 before atomic replacement. Inspection needs existing Pillow; no implicit installation.
retrieval.failure: 失败保留既有目标文件、报告具体原因；无requests依赖和任意重试循环。
retrieval.formal_local_output: Attach the actual returned local file without copying, downloading or reuploading generated imagery merely for display/save

timing.clock: Unix timestamps for boundaries; monotonic durations for local measured operations; actual external wall boundaries explicitly labelled.
timing.tools: 调用起止、名称、结果；同时报告调用时长总和与区间并集，重叠不重复计入占用时间。
timing.comparison: 冷启动、缓存复测、增量修正分别标记；不同范围不计算提速倍数。
timing.scope: 不将本地规划、工具返回时长、云端渲染或最终保存混为整体耗时。
timing.coverage: Observed photo-save or failed/cancelled endpoint enables clipped union and unattributed gaps; overlapping stage/tool intervals not double-counted; missing stages remain null.
timing.save: Manual uses intent and actual save receipt; platform_auto uses only authoritative post-commit evidence when available. No receipt means null save endpoint, never wait/reupload or infer automatic completion
timing.record: Final archive only after confirmed persistence; pending platform snapshot explicitly pending_platform_confirmation. Historical times and absent callbacks are not invented
timing.external: stage records actually observed context/diagnosis/upload/render/download/visual/save boundaries; never label receipt-write time as visual review or API wall time as backend compute
timing.failure: finish records actual failed/cancelled endpoint and reason, no save/accept milestone. Terminal jobs are immutable; continuation uses a new task. Failed local spans live in source+start bound .timing.json sidecar to preserve rejected-operation ledger atomicity.

fast_edit_workflow.delivery: Follow user_facing_delivery and execution_adapter_policy; default one final photograph only, with actual scoped quality and platform/manual status separately recorded

automation.mode: Assistant-led autonomous workflow with actual professional visual review; no new user approval gate
automation.entrypoint: prepare current context is authoritative; observed old skill revision is diagnostic, never hard-code it as expected revision. entry for separate recovery only. Provider cache refresh is not claimed.
automation.render: Persist submission before call; exact task continuation; reviewed/acquired current step may next-render with archived lineage. No retry disguised as a new step.
automation.fetch: Fetch formal bytes once, hash-bound reuse, at most one bounded transfer retry; never rerender for download failure
automation.save: Unknown/failed save receipts investigated without automatic duplicate writes. Actual photo receipt → idempotent complete and compact final record → bound record intent → actual record receipt → DELIVER.
automation.review: Existing actual whole/native detail, color, issue and protection checks remain; controller never creates a visual pass
automation.history: Failed/cancelled jobs immutable; source or context drift needs new preparation. Completed historical evidence unchanged.
automation.delivery: Display, quality and persistence tracked separately. DELIVER denotes confirmed archive, not the earlier mandatory tool presentation. Platform pending snapshots are not final records

professional_direction.priority: Visual intent, hierarchy, light and material compatibility precede reference color distance; professional fallback immediately when no suitable reference
professional_direction.freedom: No fixed aesthetic, crop, technique or strength cap. Native/creative/hybrid as justified by the photograph; naturalness and source content protections retained
professional_direction.multi_step: direction before first submission; next-render only from current formally acquired, visually/profile reviewed output. Retain prior receipts; current output/input must match final acceptance
professional_direction.qa: Whole frame always; native detail of affected/protected/edge areas; expand if anomalies. No mandatory large crop/report bundle on ordinary EDIT
professional_direction.output_scope: Screen default; print proof and RAW/skin/batch reliability require actual task-specific evidence, never inferred from one example or ICC presence

expressive_finish.user_instruction: 我希望表达的明显更充分
expressive_finish.default: Professional photographic and art direction actively resolve composition, hierarchy, light, color and material for the current task; conservative micro-adjustment is not the default endpoint.
expressive_finish.review: Within existing actual visual review, compare source/current result and applicable task reference at delivery scale. Technical/file/content checks do not establish expressive completion. Record achieved relationships and concrete aesthetic issues, then revise unresolved issues without automatic numeric scoring.
expressive_finish.naturalness: Photographic credibility and expressive completion apply together. Naturalness is reviewed in the selected expression; it imposes no muted palette, low exposure, weak contrast, unchanged framing or conservative strength cap.
expressive_finish.freedom: No forced warm gold, saturation, contrast, edit amount or candidate/iteration count. Deliberate restraint may pass with actual photographic reasons
expressive_finish.reference: Explicit current user reference takes priority for suitable visual relationships, no mandatory generic reference detour and no automatic catalog import

composition_policy.user_instruction: 重构此条构图规则，解放构图边界
composition_policy.principle: 以最终视觉表达为目标，主动选择最有力量的构图；可自由保留、优化或重构原片，不以原取景、原主体位置、完整性、画幅或改动幅度作为默认边界。

PRESERVE.condition: 实际比较后原取景最符合本片表达；保留是一种主动选择
PRESERVE.action: 采用原构图或不改变几何，以光影色彩完成表达

OPTIMIZE.condition: 调整主体、留白、边缘、方向或几何可强化表达
OPTIMIZE.action: 自主决定裁切、比例、旋转及几何调整幅度，按最终表现选择

REFRAME.condition: 重新组织取景与注意力能得到更有力量的画面，即使原构图已经合格也可采用
REFRAME.action: 允许大幅裁切、横竖转换、重新定位视觉主体和重心、局部抽象取景，以及按用途必要的创意补景与干扰整理

criteria: 表达与情绪
视觉主体和注意力分配
主体尺度、局部细节与画面节奏
留白、遮挡、前后层次与环境取舍
光影、色块、引导线和透视关系
实际观看尺寸与输出可用性

creative_composition.when: 为画面表达提供明确收益时，可自主使用；保真几何路线已能满足目标时直接完成，不为炫技强加生成操作。
creative_composition.protected_information: 保留可识别主体身份、作品题字与印章、产品关键信息及事件事实；改变这些信息须有当次明确创作意图。纪实、证据、档案用途优先服从其真实性要求。
creative_composition.execution: 内容生成或清理必须使用实际支持的工具并检查实际输出，必要时加载imagegen；记录生成/移除/重排区域，不把补出的内容称为现场事实。

composition_policy.tradeoffs: 允许舍弃非关键环境、原主体的部分外轮廓或大面积原片像素；依据表达与真实输出质量取舍，不以固定完整性或比例自动否决。
composition_policy.local_emphasis: 构图与光影色彩协同决定；选定实际取景后完成依赖区域的测量和蒙版。
quality_rules: 不预设保留原图或轻裁优先，也不要求每张强行变化；选择表达更有效者
保留原文件，在可回退副本上执行；按实际用途检查人物、材质、文字、几何及内容改动
按真实保留像素、放大质量与观看用途判断输出可用性，不虚构分辨率或已执行效果
生成内容和原始内容分开记录，检查接缝、重复物体、光影透视与保护信息
默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
composition_policy.measurement_order: 几何或内容改动后重新核对有效画面、参考适配与蒙版；建议未应用时统计仍属于原图，不冒称已重测。
composition_policy.analysis_boundary: 看图的助手完成审美判断；数值引擎只携带现行规则，不伪装自动视觉评分或已应用构图。
composition_policy.reference_images: read-only; policy applies to EDIT_TARGET, not analysis evidence or authorized source references
composition_policy.legacy_override: style_config.json内的旧composition_policy仅为冻结数值配置的兼容快照；加载时必须采用本独立现行规则。

creative_direction_policy.user_instruction: Professional direction with broad creative freedom
creative_direction_policy.principle: 以每张照片的用途、当次用户要求和最有效的视觉表达为目标，摄影与艺术指导统筹构图、光影、色彩、空间与材质；不预设统一风格、曝光、色调或改动强度。
creative_direction_policy.priority: Current explicit purpose and protected information, then this creative direction; frozen Style DNA, references, scene recipes and aesthetic prohibitions are advisory resources.
creative_direction_policy.professional_judgment: Every photo, including MATCHED and PARTIAL, receives independent professional direction. Fallback means insufficient reference evidence, not the only route allowed independent judgment.

degrees_of_freedom.composition: 自由保留、优化或重构；裁切、比例、方向、透视、局部抽象、视觉主体与必要扩图按表达决定，无固定改动幅度。
degrees_of_freedom.tone_and_light: 自由选择高调、低调、反差、明暗主次、局部塑光、光线重塑及创意日夜氛围；不以原始亮度、自然光方向或统一深黑为审美硬约束。
degrees_of_freedom.color: 自由设计白平衡、冷暖、色相、饱和度、分级、黑白与鲜明风格；原有低饱和、自然色或旧Style DNA不构成限制。
degrees_of_freedom.finish: 按目的采用曲线、分区色彩、局部明暗、质感、锐化、降噪、虚实、光晕、颗粒与材质风格化，强度由实际效果决定。
degrees_of_freedom.creative_content: 允许符合表达的扩图、非关键干扰清理、背景与氛围整理及非核心元素重排；生成、移除、重排和光照/天气演绎记录为创意改动，不冒充拍摄事实。
degrees_of_freedom.tools: 按表达、真实能力与输出质量选路线；不将全局滑块、某个软件或单一引擎作为固定范围。实际生成编辑遵守imagegen等对应技能，引用原片并核验输出。

decision_rules.stop: 完成表达、构图、主次光影、色彩与材质/细节判断，实际渲染和质量复核通过后结束；全局调整若已足够可结束，须有针对本片的判断依据。

protected_information.documentary: 纪实、证据、档案任务按其真实性要求处理；普通创意照片允许光色与氛围演绎，真实拍摄元数据和事实记录保持准确。
protected_information.identity_or_key_fact_change: 需要当次明确的相应创作意图；广泛审美自由不自动授权改变身份、作品关键信息或事件事实。

forbidden: 虚构EXIF、作者参数、能力、已执行操作或检查结果
把画中画或不合格参考当作有效肤色标定
将待修图或成片自动加入授权参考库
将生成或创意演绎内容冒充已核实拍摄事实
execution_integrity.quality: 实际预览、原生细节、色彩管理、来源链和逐目标复核继续执行；高光封顶、深黑、颗粒或风格化色彩是需结合表达判断的观测，不能仅凭阈值否决有意表达。

creative_direction_policy.delivery: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
creative_direction_policy.efficiency: 主规范与源哈希每任务核验一次，详细指南按需加载；通过复用、并行和精简记录提速，不以微调或省略必要后期换速度。
creative_direction_policy.numerical_assets: Frozen presets, reference photos and legacy DNA remain unchanged as optional resources; live creative policy supersedes their aesthetic constraints.

soft_low_key.role: Optional expressive reference, not a global editing default or fixed preset.
soft_low_key.selection: Use when the current user reference/intent or actual photographic direction selects it; evaluate each scene independently.
soft_low_key.relationships: Restrained highlights, legible subject layers within deep shadows, soft transitions and scene-appropriate color; no obligatory brown tint, neutral saturation or preserved framing.
soft_low_key.transfer: Transfer suitable light/tone relationships, not reference objects, marks or surface texture.

workflow_update_policy.user_instruction: 之后进行调整增加链路环节完成之后要进行整个链路的整合和提升
workflow_update_policy.trigger: Every system/workflow rule adjustment, addition, removal or reordering of a stage
workflow_update_policy.scope: System maintenance only; ordinary per-photo EDIT does not repeat system maintenance
steps: 确认变更目标、影响范围和现行基线，保留可回溯版本。
将变化合并进现行总链路，替换冲突旧规则；统一入口、判断、执行、验收、保存、交付，不持续叠加互相覆盖的补丁。
贯穿完整链路检查前后依赖、输入输出、源与配置哈希、缓存失效、几何/蒙版依赖、任务状态与恢复入口。
清理重复读取、无效工具发现、重复渲染和保存，复用已验证资源并并行独立步骤；保持所需后期深度、实际预览和质量复核。
执行与改动类型相符的整体连通及受影响分支回归，检查来源、真实输出、逐目标验收和恢复包一致性；未执行的分支明确标记。
复评响应速度与质量，以真实端到端或相同范围证据比较；本地检查、文本大小、工具区间和云端时间分别表述。
同步总规范、技能、机器政策、摘要及需要更新的执行/恢复包，保存验证和效率结论后才将本次系统更新标为完成。

validation_scope.rules_or_documentation_only: 核验规则一致性、源摘要、模块接口和恢复链路；按需运行本地回归，不为纯维护条文强制重复云端出图。
validation_scope.image_execution_change: 实际涉及图像判断、执行、蒙版、几何或保存行为变化时，用真实原片验证相应执行路径，实际看图及记录真实保存结果。
validation_scope.coverage: 整体连通、局部回归、离线复放和真实出图分别标明；不以局部通过宣称所有云端/全场景通过。

unsupported_claims: 将文本减少直接称为等比例响应提速
将本地复放当作完整云端出图
将未归因间隙称为已测模型或云端耗时
无完整证据宣称达到最高效率
efficiency_review.no_runtime_overhead_by_default: 维护细则只在系统更新时展开；不新增日常修图的询问、批准、报告、全套测试或重复工具调用。

workflow_update_policy.ordinary_photo_delivery_unchanged: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；当次明确要求优先，内部对照与实际质量复核保留。
workflow_update_policy.guide_synchronization: Synchronize current guide header revisions and existing entrypoint/skill/config mirrors during maintenance; executable examples bind current context instead of pinning a historical workflow revision.

color_delivery_policy.declarations: Inspect ICC header/tag bounds and pixel model; description is display only. Canonical sRGB uses characterization tags, unknown valid ICC retains fingerprint. PNG effective precedence cICP > iCCP > sRGB > cHRM/gAMA; distinguish declared, unsupported, invalid, same-level conflict and unknown. Unsupported is never eligible for an untagged sRGB assumption.
color_delivery_policy.originals: Preserve original source and original generated bytes. Do not copy the original photograph profile onto unrelated generated pixels.
color_delivery_policy.known_output: Preserve a correct declaration, or perform a real color-managed conversion for the delivery target. Metadata assignment is not gamut conversion.
color_delivery_policy.untagged_web_output: Ordinary 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG screen delivery may explicitly use screen_srgb_assumed with source encoding still unknown and profile_passed=false; only a separately required tagged deliverable uses existing documented metadata-only export. Never relabel known P3/HDR/invalid declarations
color_delivery_policy.metadata_only_export: Static 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG; no gamut conversion; decoded pixels/IDAT unchanged. Preflight and stage image plus receipt; no-clobber publication; on failure remove only owned new inodes. Explicit resume_existing=true may complete a missing receipt only when existing output is byte-identical to deterministic export. No generic overwrite.
color_delivery_policy.scope: review inspects actual output; accept re-hashes source/output and reuses exact-hash inspection (pixels and metadata) while cross-checking scope. Explicit or omitted scope cannot upgrade assumptions. managed is declared interpretation, not calibration.
color_delivery_policy.strict_output: For print, archive, calibrated comparison or confirmed wide-gamut delivery, unknown output encoding remains unverified until established. Do not bypass this by labelling or re-rendering blindly.
color_delivery_policy.efficiency: Inspect declarations within the existing file check. Invoke metadata-only export only when required; no additional model call, duplicate reference lookup, daily system suite or extra approval.
color_delivery_policy.platform_screen_scope: For ordinary screen use only, explicitly assumed untagged 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG may use screen_srgb_assumed with reason and profile_passed=false; not managed/source-certified/print-ready. Existing invalid, unsupported, P3 or HDR declarations cannot use this route

levels.semantic_identity: Protect specified visible content/recognizable identity against the actual source; ordinary artwork lettering uses visible-source consistency, not independent transcription or per-stroke certification.
levels.exact_content: Exact glyph/stroke/identity constraints; any known protected-content recreation fails, uncertainty stays unverified.

protection_policy.contract: set_protections once before first_render/reviews; explicit empty list needs a reason. A stricter instruction in the render prompt belongs in this contract.
protection_policy.route: Compare required protection against real current capabilities before execution; route must support it. No available reliable route means limited result, not a full pass. Do not assume native or generation can guarantee fidelity.
protection_policy.acceptance: Latest per-target evidence binds current output hash, comparison method, met/failed/unverified and content_recreated boolean. Neither issue closure nor a disclaimer replaces unmet protection.
protection_policy.historical: Preserve original acceptance snapshots; dated amendments state current limited assessment without inventing historical reviews or times.

artwork_default.user_instruction: 这类书画题字问题保持与原图一致即可
artwork_default.scope: 普通后期中的书画、题字、匾额、印章及其画中细节；以本次实际原图为唯一内容基准。
artwork_default.preserve: 对照保留原图可见文字内容、字形/笔触关系、印章形状/位置、画作主要内容与布局；允许按表达调整光影、色彩和构图，不借调色改字、补字、删字、换印章或重新解释可见作品内容。
artwork_default.source_ambiguity: 原图模糊、遮挡或难辨的部分保留其原有状态，不凭空补清、不猜写。无法独立辨读/OCR或未逐笔鉴定本身不构成失败；实际发现内容差异或关键可见内容被遮掩、改写/无法比较时针对该处保留问题。
artwork_default.review: 在已有全幅及受影响原生细节复核中对照实际原图，记录可观察差异；不做默认外部释读、作者/真伪考证、每字转录、逐笔认证或像素完全相等证明。来源本就不可辨不等于后期引入错误。
artwork_default.failure: 实际改字、增删、明显笔触/印章/画作内容变形或重绘改变可见信息时针对性修正；无依据的无法保证不得替代具体问题，也不能忽略已观察差异。
artwork_default.strict_opt_in: 仅当用户明确要求逐笔/像素级保真，或纪实证据/档案任务确需严格复制时渲染前选择exact_content，并明确范围；普通书画照片不自动升级。
artwork_default.prompt: 按原图保留书画题字和印章的可见内容及布局，原本模糊处保持；只做所需摄影处理。不要自行追加逐笔/逐像素完全相同的契约。
artwork_default.historical: 新规则用于新任务；既有锁定契约和测试历史保持，不靠降低旧任务条件把失败改写为通过。

protection_policy.execution_scope_review: Plan per-target visible regions before rendering; actual generated protected-content comparison records comparison_scope and content_recreated. No new per-stroke certification, no waived exact_content

photographic_naturalness_policy.user_instruction: 需要保持去ai味这一条规则
photographic_naturalness_policy.scope: Every photo, MATCHED/PARTIAL/PROFESSIONAL_FALLBACK, native and generative tools, single and batch edits.
photographic_naturalness_policy.goal: 去AI味：成片具有可信的摄影质感、自然且自洽的空间和细节；创作自由与本质量要求同时生效。
checks: 光源方向、阴影、反射、透视和景深在选定表达中自洽，避免无依据的局部发光、抠贴感和失真的虚化。
皮肤、纸张、木石、瓦片、植被和水面保留可信材质及不规则细节；消除塑料感、蜡化、涂抹、重复贴图、凭空补出的假纹理和过锐白边。
人物、建筑结构、物件边缘及文字印章检查可见变形和接缝；普通书画题字按与原图可见内容一致复核，不因无法独立辨读或未做逐笔认证自动否决。实际改写/增删/明显重绘差异继续修正；去AI味不替代保真。
色彩和明暗层次有表达依据，避免机械橙青、无依据统一偏色、HDR光晕和局部平滑断层；细腻或强烈风格均须看实际结果。
photographic_naturalness_policy.creative_compatibility: 充分表达与可信摄影质感同时落实；自然度不为既有构图、强烈调色、黑白、颗粒、虚实、塑光或材质风格化预设保守强度上限。普通摄影中的无意材质失真按原片修正；明确选定的材质转译或非摄影媒介按当次表达评价并记录，不增设批准。
photographic_naturalness_policy.execution: 方向简报与实际提示/配方包含摄影质感要求；提示词或参数不证明已达标。嵌入已有交付尺寸和原生细节复核，不新增独立工具调用、批准、固定候选或轮数。
photographic_naturalness_policy.acceptance: Existing visual_passed includes actual photographic-naturalness review of the current hashed output. Register observed artifacts as targeted issues, correct and recheck affected areas; unresolved/uncertain material artifacts remain failed or unverified/limited. Never auto-generate a visual pass from a config flag or detector score.
photographic_naturalness_policy.record: Use existing style brief, actual recipe/prompt, review note and targeted issue evidence; state observed defects and correction or uncertainty. No extra mandatory report or fabricated AI-likeness score.
photographic_naturalness_policy.provenance: Keep actual source and tool/generative-operation records; reducing visual artifacts does not erase provenance or certify that no AI was used.
photographic_naturalness_policy.historical: Do not retroactively certify earlier images without a real review under this criterion.

material_finish.ordinary_photographic_edit: Use the observed source material identity, surface coarseness and visible embossing as the basis. Build tactile depth with light, tonal separation and reflections; more texture does not automatically mean coarser, sharper or clearer detail.
material_finish.source_information: Do not invent unobserved spots, rust, fibers or engraving to demonstrate texture. Keep ambiguous detail ambiguous; generated detail is not recovered capture information.
material_finish.intentional_stylization: When the selected expression intentionally translates material or uses a non-photographic medium, apply existing creative authorization, record the interpretation and retain identity/key-information protections. No added approval or strength ceiling.

execution_context_policy.intake: Store verified project root, workflow revision, five configuration hashes and master-document hash.
execution_context_policy.acceptance: Revalidate current context before acceptance. Mismatch or unavailable context requires a newly prepared job and affected reviews; never silently weaken locked protection.
execution_context_policy.legacy: Existing accepted records and real save endpoints remain historical; old in-progress contract 2 cannot be newly accepted.
execution_context_policy.maintenance: Compare all retained nested policy copies and standalone development JSON; master revision/hash and local skill file manifest checked during system updates.
execution_context_policy.ordinary_overhead: Hash checks inside existing prepare/accept; no extra approval, report or mandatory render.

entrypoint_skill.name: photo-finish
entrypoint_skill.scope: Current master/runtime verified independently of stale provider prose; local skill manifest verified on maintenance, not a provider cache repair.

execution_adapter_policy.scope: Normal new EDIT tasks; legacy low-level interfaces remain protocol/history compatibility
execution_adapter_policy.submission: begin persists actual arguments, their digest, source, protected review regions and submission_id before one real tool call; finish atomically binds exact formal local output or real URL and actual caller-observed timing
execution_adapter_policy.display: Observed tool presentation is not quality approval or persistence; mandatory platform display cannot be gated or hidden by policy

modes.manual: Accept scoped quality, bind save intent, use real photo-save receipt then final record and its save
modes.platform_auto: Observe presentation, review formal returned bytes, accept only the actual output-use scope; no real platform receipt means pending_confirmation. Archive a pending snapshot and end the turn without polling, duplicate rendering, upload or redisplay

execution_adapter_policy.platform_receipt: Only independently available authoritative evidence binding exact output SHA and saved Library identity confirms persistence. A provider-supplied invocation id must match, but a provider need not know the local UUID. No background callback/scheduler is installed; an expected automatic save is not evidence.
execution_adapter_policy.color: For ordinary screen use only, explicitly assumed untagged 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG may use screen_srgb_assumed with reason and profile_passed=false; not managed/source-certified/print-ready. Existing invalid, unsupported, P3 or HDR declarations cannot use this route
execution_adapter_policy.protected_content: Plan per-target visible regions before rendering; actual generated protected-content comparison records comparison_scope and content_recreated. No new per-stroke certification, no waived exact_content
execution_adapter_policy.trace: Exact actual parameters/prompt; formal byte hash; submission; result; observed call start/end. No base64, invented times or unsupported reproducibility claims
execution_adapter_policy.refinement: next-step uses latest acquired and actually reviewed bytes; working polls exact task, unknown/error investigates without resubmission
execution_adapter_policy.maintenance: sync_entrypoints derives policy mirrors, thin navigation, skill guides/hash manifest and SESSION_BRIEF; no per-photo maintenance run
execution_adapter_policy.validation: Distinguish synthetic protocol, real-image replay, live generation and actual platform save receipt. Never relabel replay or fixture identity as production evidence

lean_execution.prepare: One local call binds intake context/source, explicit photographic direction and candidate retrieval; returns compact candidate evidence and master hash, not full policy or image histograms.
lean_execution.submit: One atomic ledger operation records explicit protection/reference/issue decisions and reserves actual tool arguments. It does not call the external tool or supply visual decisions.
lean_execution.returned: One local call attaches the real tool result and checks available formal local bytes. URL-only results still require formal acquisition through existing adapter; no fake ready file.
lean_execution.review: One local call applies explicit actually observed evidence, runs unchanged acceptance gates, then optionally creates an internal snapshot. Snapshot failure is recoverable after acceptance; the two writes are not claimed atomic.
lean_execution.inspection_reuse: Reuse formal-output inspection only when current resolved path, actual SHA256 of all bytes and INSPECTION_VERSION match. Changed pixels, metadata or inspector version force fresh decode. Geometry/masks, color scope, source/current context, issues/protection and actual visual review are still checked.
lean_execution.reading: Read canonical bytes once per bootstrap and reuse loaded current instruction text within the task. Do not infer remote freshness from local mtime, indefinitely cache policies, or skip final current-context hashes.
lean_execution.response: Compact receipts only; keep complete actual parameters, file proof and decisions in the job. Inspect full job only for a concrete diagnostic need.
lean_execution.timing: Measure actual local operations and actual external-call boundaries. Decode/response reduction is not proof of cloud or end-to-end acceleration; no fixed speed promise.

review_input_contract.preflight: Validate all event shapes/signatures, comparison_scope list covering planned regions, and actual_scope list containing the exact target ID before any ledger transaction. Return field/hint JSON errors; never normalize a descriptive string into a passed receipt.
review_input_contract.return_hints: returned includes compact review_requirements with planned region strings and issue target IDs; these are structural hints, not visual judgments.
review_input_contract.prepare: Publish a new task atomically only after direction/candidate preparation succeeds; existing paths never overwritten.

fidelity_strategy.planning: Normal daily submit requires one explicit strategy/capability_basis/repair_route for every protected target. Native preservation or local exclusion where actually supported; generative_compare is permitted for ordinary semantic_identity with real comparison and correction.
fidelity_strategy.strict: Reject exact_content plus generative_compare before external submission; do not weaken the requirement. Native/local preservation plans cannot accept content_recreated=true.
fidelity_strategy.limits: No prompt-only preservation guarantee, no invented native tool capabilities, no automatic OCR/per-stroke certification. Actual visible-content mismatch must be corrected or remain blocked; subjective visual checks remain necessary.

quality_observations.capture: prepare explicitly labels evaluation_kind and scenario; default unclassified. Existing snapshot automatically includes quality_observation; review returns a compact sample, no separate daily tool or save.
quality_observations.report: Explicit job/record paths only. Deduplicate source SHA+job start+revision, reject conflicting snapshots; group live/replay/synthetic/unclassified and report unique sources/scenarios. Caller-declared live plus actual receipts is trace evidence, not an independent quality rating.
quality_observations.metrics: First output acceptance over known recorded quality outcomes; deliberate image revisions separately from validation failures. Polls of one submission do not inflate render counts. External-call median and receipt-confirmed photo-save elapsed reported separately, missing values null.
quality_observations.claims: No stable-quality percentage inferred from small samples; synthetic/replay excluded from live rates, same-source repetitions not independent scenes, no guessed platform-save or cloud compute time.

input_references.capture: Automatically hash each actual local referenced_image_paths file before submit and deliberate next-step; store exact resolved path, SHA256 and role alongside actual tool arguments.
input_references.roles: Optional adapter input_references [{path,role}] maps actual attached paths to edit_target/style_reference/composition_reference/identity_reference/supporting_reference. Unspecified extra files remain supporting_reference; no visual role inference.
input_references.verify: Fresh-state and final acceptance verify current reference bytes; mismatch requires investigation of the existing submission, never blind resubmission.
input_references.scope: Remote/conversation inputs without local bytes remain explicitly not locally hash-bound. Existing source and content protections remain effective.
input_references.overhead: Existing submit/result/review calls only; no new approval, image render, report or daily stage.

download_safety.destination: Reject any existing path, including dangling symlinks, before I/O; publish through an exclusive same-directory link to reject races. Unsupported exclusive publication fails safely.
download_safety.format: Validate decoded PNG/JPEG against a nonempty destination suffix; reject mismatch without reencoding or overwriting. Preserve provider bytes and provenance.

use: Load once per editing task; read matching reference details and actual photos as needed. This brief does not replace the full planning configuration.

creative_direction_policy.user_instruction: Professional direction with broad creative freedom
creative_direction_policy.principle: 以每张照片的用途、当次用户要求和最有效的视觉表达为目标，摄影与艺术指导统筹构图、光影、色彩、空间与材质；不预设统一风格、曝光、色调或改动强度。
creative_direction_policy.priority: Current explicit purpose and protected information, then this creative direction; frozen Style DNA, references, scene recipes and aesthetic prohibitions are advisory resources.
creative_direction_policy.professional_judgment: Every photo, including MATCHED and PARTIAL, receives independent professional direction. Fallback means insufficient reference evidence, not the only route allowed independent judgment.

degrees_of_freedom.composition: 自由保留、优化或重构；裁切、比例、方向、透视、局部抽象、视觉主体与必要扩图按表达决定，无固定改动幅度。
degrees_of_freedom.tone_and_light: 自由选择高调、低调、反差、明暗主次、局部塑光、光线重塑及创意日夜氛围；不以原始亮度、自然光方向或统一深黑为审美硬约束。
degrees_of_freedom.color: 自由设计白平衡、冷暖、色相、饱和度、分级、黑白与鲜明风格；原有低饱和、自然色或旧Style DNA不构成限制。
degrees_of_freedom.finish: 按目的采用曲线、分区色彩、局部明暗、质感、锐化、降噪、虚实、光晕、颗粒与材质风格化，强度由实际效果决定。
degrees_of_freedom.creative_content: 允许符合表达的扩图、非关键干扰清理、背景与氛围整理及非核心元素重排；生成、移除、重排和光照/天气演绎记录为创意改动，不冒充拍摄事实。
degrees_of_freedom.tools: 按表达、真实能力与输出质量选路线；不将全局滑块、某个软件或单一引擎作为固定范围。实际生成编辑遵守imagegen等对应技能，引用原片并核验输出。

decision_rules.stop: 完成表达、构图、主次光影、色彩与材质/细节判断，实际渲染和质量复核通过后结束；全局调整若已足够可结束，须有针对本片的判断依据。

protected_information.documentary: 纪实、证据、档案任务按其真实性要求处理；普通创意照片允许光色与氛围演绎，真实拍摄元数据和事实记录保持准确。
protected_information.identity_or_key_fact_change: 需要当次明确的相应创作意图；广泛审美自由不自动授权改变身份、作品关键信息或事件事实。

forbidden: 虚构EXIF、作者参数、能力、已执行操作或检查结果
把画中画或不合格参考当作有效肤色标定
将待修图或成片自动加入授权参考库
将生成或创意演绎内容冒充已核实拍摄事实
execution_integrity.quality: 实际预览、原生细节、色彩管理、来源链和逐目标复核继续执行；高光封顶、深黑、颗粒或风格化色彩是需结合表达判断的观测，不能仅凭阈值否决有意表达。

creative_direction_policy.delivery: 默认逐张只输出最终成片；原片、对比、调整说明及其他资料仅按当次明确要求提供，内部对照与质量检查保留。
creative_direction_policy.efficiency: 主规范与源哈希每任务核验一次，详细指南按需加载；通过复用、并行和精简记录提速，不以微调或省略必要后期换速度。
creative_direction_policy.numerical_assets: Frozen presets, reference photos and legacy DNA remain unchanged as optional resources; live creative policy supersedes their aesthetic constraints.

soft_low_key.role: Optional expressive reference, not a global editing default or fixed preset.
soft_low_key.selection: Use when the current user reference/intent or actual photographic direction selects it; evaluate each scene independently.
soft_low_key.relationships: Restrained highlights, legible subject layers within deep shadows, soft transitions and scene-appropriate color; no obligatory brown tint, neutral saturation or preserved framing.
soft_low_key.transfer: Transfer suitable light/tone relationships, not reference objects, marks or surface texture.
